description: A two-channel stereo mixer with pre-gain, pan, a high pass switch, two effects loops and chain jacks for joining mixers end to end

params.text: Sets the gain applied to that channel before anything else, from silence to twice the input
Sets the level of that channel, after the high pass filter and before the pan
Places that channel across the stereo field on a constant-power curve
Silences that channel, and with it the effects sends taken from it and the returns those sends were scaling
Puts that channel through a high pass filter at 40Hz; it comes up off
Sets how much of that channel, taken after its fader and before its pan, goes to the FX 1 send outputs
Sets how much of that channel, taken after its fader and before its pan, goes to the FX 2 send outputs

inputs.text: The left audio input of that channel
The right audio input of that channel; it follows the left input of the same channel when unpatched
Ducks that channel: 10V silences it and 0V leaves it alone, scaling the fader in between
Silences that channel while the voltage here is above 1V
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the left output at the level it arrives
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the right output at the level it arrives
The left return of that effects loop, added to the main mix at the higher of the two send settings for that loop
The right return of that effects loop; it follows the left return of the same loop when unpatched

outputs.text: The left main mix: both channels panned, the chain input and both returns
The right main mix: both channels panned, the chain input and both returns
The left send of that effects loop: both channels at their send settings, plus the matching send chain input
The right send of that effects loop: both channels at their send settings, plus the matching send chain input

notes: a return jack is scaled by the send knobs of the loop it belongs to, so an effect patched into a loop is not heard until one of that loop's send knobs is raised
the chain inputs and outputs carry a running stereo mix. Patch OUT/L and OUT/R of one mixer into IN/L and IN/R of the next to add channels, and take the last mixer's outputs as the finished mix
four further send chain inputs are configured in the module but have no jack on the panel, so a send output carries only what this mixer makes
